sources.facts: The synchronous DAY limit is 31 days, not 32. The cited sections do not define end inclusivity or DST behavior. Per the coordinator decision, OM counts a half-open [start,end) of up to 31 account-local calendar dates using the existing date-only guard, then resolves both local midnights and rejects future ends. Fall-back can span 745 elapsed hours; spring-forward can span 743. The timezone quote is from the async section; calendar counting for synchronous DST windows is OM's interpretation, not a documented vendor guarantee.

sources.facts: HTTPS adsapi.snapchat.com/v1; Bearer header. Organization-admin-created OAuth app required.
Authorization-code flow and refresh endpoint; snapchat-marketing-api permits reads/writes; snapchat-offline-conversions-api is separate. Protect client secrets; Organization Admin creates apps.
FAQ specifies SSL redirects and no fixed refresh-token expiry; access removal can invalidate refresh. No loopback exception found: paste-token only.
organizations[].organization contains id/name; top-level and per-entity success. No organization-list pagination support located.
GET /organizations/{id}/adaccounts; adaccounts[].adaccount id/name/organization_id/status/currency/timezone. Selected organization must match.
GET /adaccounts/{id}/campaigns; GET /campaigns/{id}. campaigns[].campaign id/name/ad_account_id/status/start_time/end_time. Private ownership GET precedes campaign stats.
GET /adaccounts/{id}/creatives; creatives[].creative id/name/ad_account_id/type/review_status. Existing creatives only; no uploads.
Account/campaign/creative pages support limit and paging.next_link cursor; rebuild fixed URLs. SUCCESS and success appear in official examples; both supported.

Attributes table marks delivery_constraint required and specifies DAILY_BUDGET for daily_budget_micro. The Creating an Ad Squad example omits the field; omission does not establish a safe default. OM follows the explicit table: freeze/send DAILY_BUDGET and require the same readback. Missing or different values deny before egress or leave a checkpointed receipt unknown. Independent synthetic payload assertion lives in campaign-deployment.test.ts; no live compatibility claim.

metricsStatus.limits: At most 31 calendar days for DAY stats; longer windows return limit_exceeded before credentials or egress. One account metadata GET plus one stats GET, each <=15s/1MiB; <=5,000 rows. Pagination stays incomplete; missing intervals are not fabricated. Unknown watermarks stay 0/stale/provisional. Up to 10 separate campaign status reads.
